landmarks.name: twin beds
landmarks.description: Two single beds with light-colored patterned comforters and plaid pillows under a sloped wooden ceiling.

landmarks.name: white nightstand
landmarks.description: Small white three-drawer chest with a lamp, situated between the two twin beds under a small window.

landmarks.name: distressed wooden door
landmarks.description: Peeling white-painted paneled wooden door at the entrance to the tiled area.

landmarks.name: green vanity
landmarks.description: Distressed green wooden sink cabinet with towel bars on the side.

landmarks.name: glass shower enclosure
landmarks.description: Corner shower with clear glass walls and beige tile.

landmarks.name: white toilet
landmarks.description: Standard white ceramic toilet under a window with a short curtain.

landmarks.name: wooden loft railing
landmarks.description: Rustic timber railing with X-bracing overlooking the lower level.

landmarks.name: wooden armoire
landmarks.description: Tall, light-brown paneled wooden wardrobe along the elevated wooden walkway.

landmarks.name: grey trunk
landmarks.description: Large grey storage chest at the foot of the large bed with tufted headboard.

landmarks.name: upholstered armchair
landmarks.description: Light grey armchair with a matching ottoman in the corner by the wooden loft railing.

landmarks.name: wooden staircase
landmarks.description: Open-riser rustic timber staircase connecting the upper wooden level to the stone-tiled lower level.

landmarks.name: pool table
landmarks.description: Blue-felt billiard table on the stone-tiled lower level.

landmarks.name: tall grid windows
landmarks.description: Full-height wall of multi-pane grid windows and glass doors along the stone-tiled floor.

landmarks.name: wooden dining table
landmarks.description: Long rustic wooden table surrounded by matching wooden chairs with metal accents.

landmarks.name: stainless steel range
landmarks.description: Large commercial-style stainless steel stove flanked by green cabinets.

landmarks.name: white farmhouse sink
landmarks.description: Wide white apron-front sink set into distressed light-wood cabinetry under a window.

landmarks.name: arched hutch
landmarks.description: Distressed light-wood cabinet with an arched opening over a tiled backsplash and open lower shelves.

landmarks.name: white console table
landmarks.description: Long distressed white wooden table with drawers and lower shelves holding green plates.

landmarks.name: wall map
landmarks.description: Large white framed map mounted on the wooden wall beside the lower wooden stairs.

landmarks.name: lower wooden stairs
landmarks.description: Staircase with wooden treads and an ornate dark metal railing leading down to the brick-floored level.

landmarks.name: stone wall with recessed windows
landmarks.description: Rough-stacked stone wall along the stairwell featuring deep-set small windows.

landmarks.name: wooden bench
landmarks.description: High-backed wooden bench with light cushions set into a niche at the end of the brick floor.

landmarks.name: patterned area rug
landmarks.description: Large faded beige and pastel patterned rug lying on the brick floor.

landmarks.name: open white door
landmarks.description: White paneled wooden door standing open next to the wooden bench on the brick floor.

landmarks.name: wooden flag
landmarks.description: Rustic painted wooden American flag with a circle of stars, mounted on the wall above a small table.

landmarks.name: grey stone pillar
landmarks.description: Short, freestanding grey stone post with a low stone basin at its base on the brick floor near the open white door.

landmarks.name: magazine shelves
landmarks.description: Recessed wooden wall shelves stacked with magazines and papers next to the wooden post.

landmarks.name: dark exterior door
landmarks.description: Wide dark-wood door with a four-pane window in the upper half, set into the stone wall.

landmarks.name: grey chest of drawers
landmarks.description: Distressed grey-painted wooden dresser standing against the stone wall under a recessed window.

landmarks.name: carved floor lamp
landmarks.description: Tall, thick carved wooden floor lamp with a rectangular greenish-beige shade near the base of the wooden staircase.

landmarks.name: brown wooden sideboard
landmarks.description: Long dark-brown wooden chest of drawers backing the patchwork sofa.

landmarks.name: beige chaise lounges
landmarks.description: Pair of matching beige upholstered chaise lounges with patterned pillows near the tall grid windows.

landmarks.name: patchwork sofa
landmarks.description: Long brown and beige patchwork-upholstered sofa facing the white plaster fireplace.

landmarks.name: barrel stool
landmarks.description: Wooden barrel with a padded leather top in the corner beside the pool table.

landmarks.name: white plaster fireplace
landmarks.description: Large white fireplace with a curved mantel and metal sculptures on top.

landmarks.name: patterned wingback armchair
landmarks.description: Beige and brown patterned wingback chair next to the white plaster fireplace and built-in wooden bookshelves.

landmarks.name: grey glass-front cabinet
landmarks.description: Large light-grey wooden display cabinet with glass doors along the stone-tiled floor.

landmarks.name: double glass doors with urns
landmarks.description: Unpainted wooden double doors with multi-pane glass, flanked by two dark metal urns on the floor.

landmarks.name: large bed with tufted headboard
landmarks.description: Large bed with a white comforter, beige pillows, and a grey patterned button-tufted headboard under the sloped wooden roof.

landmarks.name: dark wooden hutch
landmarks.description: Tall rustic dark-wood cabinet with open upper shelves and lower doors, positioned next to the large bed with tufted headboard.

landmarks.name: white four-drawer chest
landmarks.description: Distressed white wooden chest of drawers with a small white lamp on top, next to the large bed under the sloped roof.

landmarks.name: built-in wooden bookshelves
landmarks.description: Tall recessed wooden shelving unit with lower cabinets, next to the Z-brace wooden door.

landmarks.name: wooden desk
landmarks.description: Rustic wooden table desk with brown leather armchairs on either side and a small wooden chest nearby.

landmarks.name: Z-brace wooden door
landmarks.description: Unpainted rustic plank wooden door with Z-bracing, standing open next to the enclosed wooden stairs.

landmarks.name: enclosed wooden stairs
landmarks.description: Narrow, steep wooden staircase enclosed by distressed wooden plank walls with a wooden handrail on the left.

landmarks.name: upholstered wooden bench
landmarks.description: Low light-wood bench with drawers and a beige cushioned top, located under a window at the end of the pool table.

landmarks.name: pool cue rack
landmarks.description: Wall-mounted wooden rack holding vertical billiard cues in the corner next to the window.

connections.how: Walk forward between the twin beds directly to the white nightstand.
Turn around and walk back between the twin beds to the doorway with the distressed wooden door.
Pass through the doorway with the distressed wooden door on your left to reach the green vanity on your left and glass shower enclosure ahead.
Turn around with the green vanity on your right and walk out through the doorway past the distressed wooden door.
From the doorway, turn left and walk along the wooden loft railing with the wooden armoire on your right.
Continue straight with the wooden loft railing on your left and the grey trunk on your right to reach the upholstered armchair.
Turn left at the wooden loft railing and walk past the wooden armoire to the top of the wooden staircase.
Descend the wooden staircase to the stone-tiled floor and loop left around the base of the stairs alongside the wooden dining table.
Walk forward with the wooden dining table on your left toward the tall grid windows ahead.
Turn right in front of the tall grid windows to face the beige chaise lounges and patchwork sofa.
Turn around with the tall grid windows on your left and walk toward the stainless steel range.
Walk past the stainless steel range on your right to the white farmhouse sink ahead.
Turn left at the white farmhouse sink and walk between the counter and the wooden dining table.
Walk along the wooden dining table on your left, passing the arched hutch on your right, to reach the white console table.
Pass the white console table on your right and turn right at the end of the wooden dining table toward the wall map and lower wooden stairs.
Descend the lower wooden stairs with the wall map and stone wall with recessed windows on your left to reach the brick floor with the patterned area rug, wooden bench, and open white door.

Walk across the brick floor past the grey stone pillar on your left and grey chest of drawers on your right to the base of the lower wooden stairs, then climb up with the stone wall with recessed windows and wall map on your right.
From the top of the lower wooden stairs, walk forward onto the stone-tiled floor to the base of the wooden staircase and carved floor lamp.

With the wooden staircase and carved floor lamp on your left, walk straight past the brown wooden sideboard on your left and the patchwork sofa and beige chaise lounges on your right to the tall grid windows.
Turn right in front of the tall grid windows and walk between the windows on your left and beige chaise lounges on your right toward the pool table and barrel stool.
At the corner with the barrel stool, turn right and walk with the pool table on your left toward the patterned wingback armchair and white plaster fireplace.
Walk past the white plaster fireplace on your left and the patchwork sofa on your right toward the grey glass-front cabinet ahead.
Turn around and walk back past the pool table on your right and beige chaise lounges on your left to the tall grid windows.
Walk away from the tall grid windows past the beige chaise lounges on your left toward the wooden staircase, then turn left between the patchwork sofa and the brown wooden sideboard.
Walk with the brown wooden sideboard on your right and the patchwork sofa on your left toward the double glass doors with urns and grey glass-front cabinet.
Walk past the double glass doors with urns on your left and wooden staircase on your right, then turn right to the top of the lower wooden stairs.
From the bottom of the lower wooden stairs near the patterned area rug, turn right toward the wooden flag and magazine shelves.
Turn left from the magazine shelves and walk past the grey stone pillar toward the open white door and wooden bench.
Turn left at the open white door and wooden bench, with the dark exterior door on your right, to face the patterned area rug.
At the top of the lower wooden stairs, turn left between the white console table and the wooden dining table, facing the arched hutch.
Walk between the white console table and wooden dining table to the base of the wooden staircase and carved floor lamp.

Climb the wooden staircase, then walk straight past the wooden armoire and distressed wooden door on your right and the grey trunk on your left to the large bed with tufted headboard and dark wooden hutch.
Turn around and walk past the dark wooden hutch and distressed wooden door on your left, and the grey trunk on your right, toward the upholstered armchair and wooden loft railing.
Turn around and walk with the wooden loft railing and upholstered armchair on your left, passing the grey trunk and large bed with tufted headboard on your right, to the white four-drawer chest.

Turn around and walk past the large bed with tufted headboard on your left and upholstered armchair and wooden loft railing on your right, then turn right at the wooden armoire onto the wooden staircase.
Descend the wooden staircase, turn right at the bottom, and walk past the carved floor lamp, brown wooden sideboard, and patchwork sofa on your right toward the double glass doors with urns.

Turn left before the double glass doors with urns and walk between the grey glass-front cabinet on your right and the patterned wingback armchair and built-in wooden bookshelves on your left to reach the wooden desk.
With the wooden desk and Z-brace wooden door on your right, walk forward through the doorway to the base of the enclosed wooden stairs.
Turn around at the base of the enclosed wooden stairs and walk back out past the Z-brace wooden door on your left to the wooden desk on your right.

Turn right past the wooden desk and walk straight with the grey glass-front cabinet and double glass doors with urns on your left, and the patterned wingback armchair and patchwork sofa on your right, to the wooden staircase and carved floor lamp.

Walk along the right side of the pool table, passing the white plaster fireplace, patterned wingback armchair, and built-in wooden bookshelves on your right, to reach the upholstered wooden bench and pool cue rack ahead.

walk_summary: Start between the twin beds and walk forward to the white nightstand.
Turn right, walk back past the twin beds, and pass through the doorway beside the distressed wooden door to the green vanity, glass shower enclosure, and white toilet.
Turn around and walk back out past the distressed wooden door and twin beds.
Turn left and walk along the wooden loft railing past the wooden armoire and grey trunk to the upholstered armchair.
Turn left and descend the wooden staircase to the stone-tiled floor, then loop left around the base of the stairs past the wooden dining table.
Walk forward between the wooden dining table and tall grid windows, then turn right toward the beige chaise lounges and patchwork sofa.
Turn around and walk past the stainless steel range to the white farmhouse sink.
Turn left and walk between the counter and the wooden dining table, then pass the arched hutch and white console table.
Turn right and descend the lower wooden stairs past the wall map and stone wall with recessed windows to the brick floor with the patterned area rug, wooden bench, and open white door.
Turn around past the wooden flag and climb back up the lower wooden stairs past the stone wall with recessed windows and wall map.
Walk past the wooden staircase, carved floor lamp, and brown wooden sideboard on the left and the patchwork sofa and beige chaise lounges on the right to the tall grid windows.
Turn right and walk along the tall grid windows past the beige chaise lounges to the pool table and barrel stool.
Turn right and walk between the pool table and patchwork sofa, passing the patterned wingback armchair and white plaster fireplace toward the grey glass-front cabinet.
Turn around and walk back past the pool table and beige chaise lounges to the tall grid windows.
Turn left toward the wooden staircase, then walk between the brown wooden sideboard and patchwork sofa toward the double glass doors with urns and grey glass-front cabinet.
Circle around the seating area near the white plaster fireplace, patchwork sofa, and grey glass-front cabinet.
Walk past the double glass doors with urns and turn right to descend the lower wooden stairs past the wall map and stone wall with recessed windows.
At the bottom of the stairs on the brick floor, turn right toward the wooden flag and magazine shelves, then turn left and walk past the grey stone pillar to the open white door and wooden bench.
Turn left with the dark exterior door on the right, walk across the brick floor past the patterned area rug and grey chest of drawers, and climb the lower wooden stairs.
At the top of the lower wooden stairs, step between the white console table and wooden dining table toward the arched hutch, then curve around the base of the wooden staircase and carved floor lamp.
Climb the wooden staircase to the upper level and walk past the wooden armoire, distressed wooden door, and grey trunk to the large bed with tufted headboard and dark wooden hutch.
Turn around and walk back to the upholstered armchair and wooden loft railing, then turn back and walk past the grey trunk and large bed with tufted headboard to the white four-drawer chest.
Turn around, walk past the large bed with tufted headboard, upholstered armchair, and wooden loft railing, and turn right at the wooden armoire to descend the wooden staircase.
At the bottom of the wooden staircase, turn right past the carved floor lamp and brown wooden sideboard toward the double glass doors with urns.
Turn left before the double glass doors with urns and walk between the grey glass-front cabinet and built-in wooden bookshelves to the wooden desk.
Walk past the wooden desk and open Z-brace wooden door to the base of the enclosed wooden stairs.

Turn around, exit past the Z-brace wooden door and wooden desk, and turn right to walk past the grey glass-front cabinet and double glass doors with urns back to the wooden staircase and carved floor lamp.
Turn right at the carved floor lamp and walk between the brown wooden sideboard and beige chaise lounges to the tall grid windows.

Turn right in front of the tall grid windows and walk along the right side of the pool table, passing the white plaster fireplace, patterned wingback armchair, and built-in wooden bookshelves to stop at the upholstered wooden bench and pool cue rack.
